name: v0.27.1
body:
**A patch release: active bottom-bar toggles are readable in the SolidCraft 95 theme, and fixes.**

SolidCraft is open-source parametric 3D CAD in Rust: sketch, constrain, extrude, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild. [Website](https://solidcraft.io) · [documentation](https://docs.solidcraft.io/) · [try it in the browser](https://solidcraft.io/app) · [Discord](https://solidcraft.io/discord) · [issues](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/issues) · [roadmap](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

## Fixed
- **SolidCraft 95 theme:** an active toggle on the view's bottom bar, such as Orthographic, showed as a blank dark blue block; its label and icon now draw in the theme's selected-text colour where the accent colour doesn't read (#9171).
- **System theme on macOS:** with Preferences › Interface › Theme set to System, the app follows a change of the macOS Appearance while it runs (#9103).
- **Older designs:** a sketch with a projected face seen edge-on, saved by an older release, keeps its line when it is rebuilt, so an offset that uses that line no longer fails (#9097).
- **Empty sketch:** a new sketch with no geometry says so in the view instead of "fully constrained" (#9104).
- **Render:** a raster render too large for the renderer is refused before it starts, with a suggestion to reduce its size or the visible geometry, instead of failing partway (#5728).
- **`solidcraft-cli mcp --param-check`** now also checks calls sent to a running app, not only a headless session (#9073).

## Compatibility
0.27.1 writes design file format 44, as 0.27.0 does. It opens every earlier design, but 0.26.x and earlier refuse a design saved by 0.27.x. Drawing files (`.scdwg`) are format 1.
